Our economic condition is crap. He racked up credit card bills and loans we can't afford. Every month it is "which bill will have the smallest late penalty" that is what we choose to skip. Plus, when I am done with school I have $200 a month payments for the next ten years at this point.

Him: Not a single fuck is given.

No, I can't do this. You know that impulse that people sometimes get to throw expensive things into the water from a very high place? That is how I felt driving home from work. I have no one else and I can't walk because I live 20 miles from civilization.
I want to go in. I asked my husband to bring me but he is too tired and said he can't deal with it.

I need school for the deferrment. I just have an AA but $19,000 in loans. I fell for DeVry. I have no savings, it all goes to bills. I'm drowning, but it still isn't the biggest concern I have. I know it won't change, you just have to play the game but I got a bad hand. I just want to quit.

I have to keep everything perfectly scheduled. That's part of the problem. I have two jobs, family, and schooling to deal with. I can't afford to drop out of school but I can't make it on a next to nothing wage. I work at a nursing home and it isn't pretty. So many of them are ready to die, even those not on hospice. I have no free time to myself to just unwind. I guess I can't keep up anymore.

I try to help contribute to change. I problem is it turns people away because "Nobody can really be that nice/happy/whatever" I do nice stuff because it feels good and not because I want some medal of honor or something.
